Happy New Year!! I hope you've had a wonderful holiday season and that you are excited to kick off 2020!
I want to invite you to schedule a quick call with me over the next several weeks to catch up. I would also like to make sure we are on the same page as far as your investment plans go, both in the short term and overall for 2020. I would love to discuss the new markets that we have added over the past year and discuss expanding your portfolio.
You can use the link below to line up a time on my calendar. Looking forward to catching up with you soon!
Click Here to schedule a 15-minute Phone Call
All the best,
Ashley
